Balcarce lies inland in the southeastern part of Buenos Aires Province, among low hills. Visitors can travel here from Mar del Plata to complement a coastal trip with an introduction to Argentina's agricultural heartland.

For agricultural professionals, Balcarce offers insight into research by INTA, work with heavy soils, grain storage and potato cultivation. We arrange technical programs around a delegation's interests and can combine scientific meetings with a visit to a producer. Travel times and the length of visits are agreed in advance; after the professional program, travelers can return to the ocean at Mar del Plata.

## Thermal Springs and Swings at the Edge of the World: What to See in Baños

### Baños, a Resort Town

The resort town of Baños lies at the foot of the constantly active Tungurahua volcano. Its famous thermal springs, known for their healing properties, gave the town its name. Its full name is Baños de Agua Santa, meaning “baths of holy water.”

## Relaxing in Baños

### Baños, Ecuador's Most Popular Resort!

Thanks to its distinctive location, Baños is one of Ecuador's most visited destinations. The surrounding area is also famous for picturesque waterfalls cascading from the lush green mountains. One of the town's landmarks is the basilica on the central square, an elegant Gothic building constructed from volcanic stone.
